lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
The shaker covers the melody in an ensemble. Write two fixes and one listening check.

FEEDBACK
Strong answer: 'Shaker plays softer; melody plays a little clearer. Leader listens from the front to check balance.'

WATCH FOR
Thinking the loudest player is the best player. Ensemble skill is balance and listening.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Form a household ensemble with body percussion or objects. Assign parts, rehearse with a count-in and record two balance changes you made.

Write a short reflection naming one artistic choice you changed and why. Movement or instrument work is optional, adult-supervised and can be described instead.
